'''Gume Saam''' was a [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was also a member of the group opposing [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine's]] growing power. During the war, he was affiliated with the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]] and swayed toward the interests of the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].

==Biography==
===Senator in the Galactic Senate===
{{Quote|This is a matter not of philosophy. More troops are needed. The Republic cannot afford to let the Separatists gain any more ground!|Saam, in support of deregulating the banks|<ref name="HoBS" />}}
[[File:Palpatine on balcony.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Gume Saam (middle right) observes the deployment of the Grand Army of the Republic on Coruscant.]]
An [[Ishi Tib/Legends|Ishi Tib]],<ref name="AOTC" /> Gume Saam served in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]]<ref name="ROTSVD" /> at the start of the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. Just after the start of that war at the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]<ref name="AOTC" /> in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]],<ref name="AOTC date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|II}} to [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]].</ref> he was present<ref name="Insider 101">{{InsiderCite|101|Ask Lobot}}</ref> on a balcony overlooking the deployment of the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]<ref name="AOTC" /> on the [[The galaxy/Legends|galactic]] [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. Saam stood behind [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Palpatine/Legends|Palpatine]], among other dignitaries of the Galactic Senate.<ref name="AOTC" />

As a Senator, Saam took kickbacks from the [[Techno Union/Legends|Techno Union]],<ref name="HoBS Episode Guide" /> which was one of the [[Megacorporation/Legends|megacorporations]] backing the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]], the opponents of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] in the Clone Wars.<ref name="AOTC" /> Around two [[Standard year/Legends|years]] into the war, in [[20 BBY/Legends|20 BBY]],<ref name="HoBS date">{{TCWdates|310}}</ref> Saam proposed a [[Republic financial reform bill/Legends|bill]] that would deregulate the banks, allowing the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] to open new lines of credit without the approval of the Galactic Senate. Saam conspired with [[Nix Card/Legends|Nix Card]], who represented the Banking Clan, and [[Lott Dod/Legends|Lott Dod]], who represented the [[Trade Federation/Legends|Trade Federation]], to pass this bill.<ref name="HoBS" />

[[File:Military_enhancement_bill.png|thumb|right|250px|Gume Saam and Lott Dod, in support of deregulating the banks.]]

In support of the bill, Saam addressed the Senate in the [[Grand Convocation Chamber]], indicating that his bill would allow the creation of more [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to aid with the war effort. He was first opposed by Senator [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Organa]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]], whose assertion that the Republic was near bankruptcy was met with both cheers and jeers. Senator Dod came to the defense of the bill, stating that opening new lines of credit would pay for the needed [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|funds]]. Senator [[Padmé Amidala/Legends|Padmé Amidala]] of [[Naboo/Legends|Naboo]], opposing the bill, proposed a [[Confederate–Republic peace initiative/Legends|peace initiative]] with the Separatists. Organa then proposed tabling debate on the bill until deregulation was further investigated as a possible course of action, which [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice Chair]] [[Mas Amedda/Legends|Mas Amedda]] agreed to do.<ref name="HoBS" />

===Conspiring with the Separatists===
[[File:SaamCardDoddAndHoloDooku-TCWS03E10.jpg|thumb|229x229px|left|Gume Saam, Lott Dod and Nix Card conspiring with Dooku]]
{{Quote|I know some people who could do something about her.|Gume Saam, speaking of Padmé Amidala|<ref name="HoBS" />}}
Following the Senate session, Saam met in the [[Republic Executive Building/Legends|Republic Executive Building]] with Senators Dod and Card, dismayed at the failure of the bill. Dod reassured Saam that he had done his part, and the three agreed that the real issue was Senator Amidala's idealism. Saam suggested silencing Amidala, but Dod and Card shot down that idea. Card then proposed instigating an attack on Coruscant itself, something which had not [[Battle of Coruscant (Jedi-Sith War)|occurred]] in almost a [[Millennium/Legends|millennium]]. Separately, Card made contact with [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]], leader of the Separatists, who tasked [[General/Legends|General]] [[Grievous/Legends|Grievous]] with deploying [[Infiltrator/Demolition droid]]s to [[Bombing of Coruscant's central power distribution grid/Legends|attack]] Coruscant's [[Central power distribution grid/Legends|central power distribution grid]].<ref name="HoBS" />

Meanwhile, Senator Amidala traveled undercover to [[Raxus Secundus/Legends|Raxus Secundus]] to meet with Senator [[Mina Bonteri/Legends|Mina Bonteri]] of the [[Separatist Senate/Legends|Separatist Senate]], to propose peace from the other side of the conflict. Bonteri was successful in lobbying the Separatist Senate to support a peace initiative. After news of this reached Coruscant, Saam, Card, and Dod directly contacted Count Dooku, who reassured them that the attack would occur as promised, and the three corporations they represented would receive their due.<ref name="HoBS" />

Amidala, supported by Organa and [[Onaconda Farr/Legends|Onaconda Farr]] of [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]], brought the discussion back to the Senate, where Farr proposed voting down Saam's bill, in light of the peace initiative's apparent success. However, Dooku's promised attack took place during the debate, cutting the power from the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] and interrupting a vote on the bill. Saam addressed the Senate once more, decrying the attack as having been caused by the Separatists. Deregulating the banks was once more proposed, this time by<ref name="HoBS" /> [[Halle Burtoni/Legends|Halle Burtoni]] of [[Kamino/Legends|Kamino]].<ref name="Burtoni Encyclopedia">{{SWE|characters|halleburtoni|Halle Burtoni}}</ref> Chancellor Palpatine expressed his support for the bill, effectively passing it.<ref name="HoBS" />

===End of the war===
In [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]],<ref name="ROTS date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of {{Film|III}} to [[19 BBY/Legends|19 BBY]].</ref> Saam attended a showing of the [[Opera/Legends|opera]] ''[[Squid Lake/Legends|Squid Lake]]'' at the [[Galaxies Opera House/Legends|Galaxies Opera House]],<ref name="ROTS">{{Film|III}}</ref> in Coruscant's [[Uscru Entertainment District/Legends|Uscru Entertainment District]].<ref name="SWC:TP">''[[Star Wars Chronicles: The Prequels]]''</ref> alongside fellow Ishi Tib<ref name="ROTS" /> [[Waks Trode/Legends|Waks Trode]], an industrialist and war profiteer.<ref name="SWC:TP" /> Saam spoke with Trode when [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]] ran past the duo to meet with Chancellor Palpatine in his [[Palpatine's private viewing box|private box]].<ref name="ROTS" />

Shortly after the Clone Wars' end, the Republic was formally transformed into the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] with the [[Declaration of a New Order]] by Palpatine.<ref name="ROTS" /> Saam became a fugitive, and a [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] on his head was issued some [[Time/Legends|time]] prior to the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]].<ref name="STAC">''[[Star Tours: The Adventures Continue]]''</ref>

==Personality and traits==
Gume Saam was an Ishi Tib with [[Color/Legends|green]] skin and yellow [[Eye/Legends|eyes]].<ref name="AOTC" /> He was unconcerned with the possible damage caused by an attack on Coruscant's power distribution grid, being more worried about his own loss of profits.<ref name="HoBS" />

==Equipment==
While in the Senate, Saam wore a gray [[Robe/Legends|robe]], brown [[Belt/Legends|belt]], and brown [[Boot/Legends|boots]].<ref name="HoBS" /> During the opera, Saam wore a more ornate brown and gold [[Clothing/Legends|robe]] with a red undershirt.<ref name="ROTSVD" />

==Behind the scenes==
Gume Saam first appeared, albeit unnamed, in {{Film|II}},<ref name="AOTC" /> released on [[May 16]], [[2002]].<ref name="AOTC release">{{ThisWeek|u0Z7i0LnXOg|Mandalorian Season 2 Directors, We Celebrate a Birthday, and More!|sw_url=video/mandalorian-season-2-directors-we-celebrate-a-birthday-and-more}}</ref> The name "Gume Saam" was not used until the release of ''[[Star Wars: Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary]]''<ref name="ROTSVD" /> on [[April 2]], [[2005]],<ref name="Planning">{{DK|url=us/9780756611286-star-wars-revenge-of-the-sith-the-visual-dictionary|text=Star Wars Revenge of the Sith: The Visual Dictionary|oldversion=20151018025119}}</ref> where he was identified as a background character in the Galaxies Opera House.<ref name="ROTSVD" /> These two Ishi Tib characters were not confirmed to be the same until the inaugural feature of "[[Ask Lobot]]" in [[Star Wars Insider 101|''Star Wars Insider'' 101]].<ref name="Insider 101" />

In his appearance in the ''[[Star Wars: The Clone Wars]]'' television series episode "[[Heroes on Both Sides]]," Gume Saam was voiced by [[Phil LaMarr]], who also voiced Senators [[Bail Prestor Organa/Legends|Bail Prestor Organa]] and [[Orn Free Taa/Legends|Orn Free Taa]] in the series.<ref name="SWArchive-''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides">{{SWArchive|url=theclonewars/guide/episode310.html|text=''The Clone Wars'' Episode Guide: Heroes on Both Sides}}</ref>
